roleContext.roleTitle: Conversational AI Engineer, Support Chat Assistant
roleContext.jobDescription: The support chat assistant answers customer questions inside the company's SaaS products and hands conversations to human agents when it cannot. The Conversational AI Engineer operates the intent and answer models behind live customer conversations: has released models into the live assistant, watches deflection and hand-off rates on live traffic, handles production model incidents such as a regression after a release or a spike in mis-routed conversations through the assistant's on-call rota, coordinates releases with the assistant platform team, and documents model limitations.

Handles model incidents such as post-release regressions or mis-routing spikes through the assistant's on-call rota.
Coordinates model releases with the assistant platform team and records own responsibility boundaries.
Trains and evaluates intent classification and answer retrieval models against held-out and replay sets with a maintained evaluation harness.
Documents model limitations and hand-over conditions in model cards and release notes.

candidate.originalCvMarkdown:
# Curriculum vitae

Target role: Conversational AI Engineer, Support Chat Assistant

## Experience

- Trained and evaluated intent classification and answer retrieval models for the support chat assistant in the model development sandbox, using the annotated conversation corpus and a replay set of anonymised past conversations as the held-out evaluation data.
- Built and maintained the offline evaluation harness that scored every candidate model on intent accuracy, retrieval recall and replay-set regressions before it was proposed for release.
- Prepared release candidates for the assistant platform team, which held the release pipeline, the live dashboards and the on-call rota; my involvement ended at the release review, and I did not have access to the live conversation data.
- Wrote the model card and the release notes for each candidate model, listing the training data cut, the replay-set results and the known failure modes on multi-intent messages.
- Over about two and a half years the work covered model training, the evaluation harness, release candidate preparation, model cards and release notes for the assistant's intent and retrieval models.

## Work samples

- Work sample: the evaluation harness report for the last three release candidates with sandbox experiment identifiers, and the model card for the intent classifier.
